title: Criteria for Disbursement of Opportunity Fund Grant to Schools
what_it_is: Criteria for Disbursement of Opportunity Fund Grant to Schools

sections.label: Opportunity Fund disbursement to schools
sections.summary: The Opportunity Fund was disbursed to schools, junior colleges, institutes, special education schools and ITE, and extended to polytechnics in 2013, based on student numbers and FAS recipients.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Initially, the Opportunity Fund was disbursed to Government and Government-aided schools, junior colleges and centralised institutes, independent schools, Ministry of Education (MOE)-supported special education schools, and the Institute of Technical Education (ITE).

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: It was subsequently extended to the polytechnics in 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The amount of Opportunity Fund disbursed to the schools is based on the total number of students and the percentage of MOE Financial Assistance Scheme (FAS) recipients in the respective schools.

sections.label: Opportunity Fund amounts and usage areas
sections.summary: About $16 million yearly goes to schools, $2 million to ITE and $5.5 million to polytechnics, used for overseas trips, enrichment programmes and ICT access.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The total amount of Opportunity Fund disbursed to the schools is about $16 million a year.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The total amount disbursed is about $2 million for ITE and about $5.5 million for the five polytechnics.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The three broad areas of usage for the Opportunity Fund are: (a) overseas trips, such as visits and exchange programmes with schools overseas; (b) enrichment programmes, such as leadership camps and creative arts workshops; and (c) access to Information and Communication Technologies (ICT), such as helping needy students to own personal computers under the Infocomm Development Authority of Singapore (IDA)'s NEU PC PLUS Programme.

sections.label: Students benefiting from scheme
sections.summary: On average, about 67,000 students benefit from the scheme each year.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: On average, about 67,000 students benefit from the scheme each year.

sections.label: Disbursement adjustments and utilisation rate
sections.summary: It is disbursed upfront and adjusted annually for changes in Singapore Citizen enrolment and FAS profile, with about 80% utilisation in the 2013-2015 cycle.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: It is usually disbursed to them upfront and adjusted annually to take into consideration the changes in Singapore Citizen enrolment numbers and their FAS profile for each year, if applicable.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, with regard to the utilisation rate for the past cycle, which was from 2013-2015, it was about 80% of the amount disbursed to all institutions.
